- [USER] User asked for the next step up in adventure activities after jet boating.

- [USER] User expressed approval of the progression plan.
- [USER] User requested recommendations for the best place to go zip lining in Queenstown.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended three places for zip lining in Queenstown:
  1. Ziptrek Ecotours - Offers various zip line tours through the forest canopy with views of Queenstown and Lake Wakatipu, including a twilight tour.
  2. Skyline Queenstown - Features a gondola ride to the top with zip lining activities and stunning views.
  3. Shotover Canyon Swing and Canyon Fox - Adrenaline-pumping activities that involve flying through the air, suitable for thrill-seekers.
- [USER] User expressed enthusiasm for zip lining at Ziptrek Ecotours.
- [USER] User asked about the duration of the zip line tour at Ziptrek Ecotours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The duration of the zip line tour at Ziptrek Ecotours typically takes between 2-3 hours, including gearing up, training, and actual zip lining.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 'Kea' tour at Ziptrek Ecotours takes approximately 3 hours and consists of six ziplines, with the first line being 300 m long and reaching speeds of up to 70 km/h. 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The experience is described as exciting and unforgettable with stunning views of Queenstown.
